WORKBOOK 56-BET. Unit 14 — dasturxon odobi, qarama-qarshi so'zlar, atrof-muhit.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 1-mashq (8 fe'l), 2-mashq (6 juftlik), 3-mashq (6 so'z), 4-mashq (8 fe'l) — jami 28 ta javob.

1-MAShQ SURATLARI (dasturxon odobi): 1 barmoq bilan ovqatlanish (eat), 2 tirsakni stolga qo'yish (put), 3 og'zi to'la gapirish (talk), 4 stolda burun qoqish (blow), 5 chekishdan oldin ruxsat so'rash (ask), 6 kechki ovqatga kechikish (be late), 7 pichoq va vilka ishlatish (use), 8 boshqaning tarelkasidan olish (take).
  ⚠ 5 va 7-band 'ALWAYS' bilan (qilish kerak), qolganlari 'NEVER' yoki 'DON'T' bilan (qilmaslik kerak).

⚠ 2-MAShQ — OLTI QARAMA-QARShILIK: dangerous↔safe · rude↔polite · upset↔content · upwards↔downwards · illegal↔legal · protect↔destroy.
  ⚠ Uchtasi INKOR QO'ShIMChASI bilan yasaladi: il-legal (in- ning shakli), down-wards / up-wards.
  ⚠ 'content' bu yerda 'mamnun, xotirjam' degani (ot emas, SIFAT). O'qilishi ham boshqa: sifat — kon-TENT, ot — KON-tent.

⚠ 3-MAShQ — KASALLIK VA MASLAHAT: javob HAR DOIM B ning maslahatidan chiqadi (jumper→cold, cough syrup→cough, toothache→dentist, aspirin→headache, tired→sleep, flu→sore throat).

⚠ 4-MAShQ MATNI — ATROF-MUHIT: protect the environment · use public transport · cars pollute the air · packaging creates rubbish · don't drop rubbish · looks and smells horrible · mustn't throw rubbish in the sea · never light fires in forests.
  ⚠ 6-band nozik: 'it looks AND SMELLS horrible' — ikkala fe'l ham bitta sifatga bog'lanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and choose verbs from the list to complete the instructions below about table manners.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va dasturxon odobi haqidagi quyidagi ko'rsatmalarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan fe'llarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU: TABLE MANNERS (dasturxon odobi)

RO'YXAT (8 ta fe'l, har biri BIR marta):
  eat, blow, ask, use, talk, be late, take, put


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Never EAT with your fingers.
  2  Don't PUT your elbows on the table.
  3  Don't TALK with your mouth full.
  4  Never BLOW your nose at the table.
  5  Always ASK before you smoke.
  6  Don't BE LATE for dinner.
  7  Always USE a knife and fork.
  8  Never TAKE food from someone else's plate.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Hech qachon qo'lingiz bilan ovqat yemang.
  2  Tirsaklaringizni stolga qo'ymang.
  3  Og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmang.
  4  Dasturxonda hech qachon burningizni
     qoqmang.
  5  Chekishdan oldin doim ruxsat so'rang.
  6  Kechki ovqatga kechikmang.
  7  Doim pichoq va sanchqidan foydalaning.
  8  Hech qachon birovning likopchasidan ovqat
     olmang.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  Ayol IKKI QO'LLAB katta bo'lakni yeyapti
  2  Ayol TIRSAKLARINI stolga qo'yib o'tiribdi
  3  Ayol og'zi to'la holda yon tomonga
     GAPIRYAPTI
  4  Erkak dasturxonda BURNINI QOQYAPTI
  5  Ayol dasturxonda SIGARET tutgan
  6  Odamlar allaqachon o'tirishibdi, biri
     KECh KELDI
  7  Erkak pichoq va sanchqi bilan ovqatlanyapti
  8  Ayol yonidagi odamning LIKOPChASIDAN
     ovqat olyapti


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR FE'LNING
'HAMROHI' BOR:

  ...with your FINGERS   →  EAT
  ...your ELBOWS         →  PUT
  ...with your MOUTH FULL →  TALK
  ...your NOSE           →  BLOW
  ...before you SMOKE    →  ASK
  ...for DINNER          →  BE LATE
  ...a KNIFE AND FORK    →  USE
  ...FOOD from someone's plate → TAKE

  Har bo'shliqdan keyingi so'z faqat BITTA
  fe'lga mos keladi — taxmin kerak emas.


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'BE LATE':
  Ro'yxatdagi yagona IKKI SO'ZLI shakl:
     'Don't BE LATE for dinner.'

  'be' fe'li kerak, chunki 'late' — SIFAT.
  'late FOR' — predlog 'for'.


DIQQAT — 'BLOW YOUR NOSE':
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham
  bor edi:
  'don't blow your nose in public'

  Bu yerda esa 'AT THE TABLE' (dasturxonda).


DIQQAT — 'WITH YOUR MOUTH FULL':
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Angliya matnidan:
  'Don't talk with your mouth full.'

  Ya'ni bu qoida ANGLIYA odobiga tegishli.


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'ASK':
  'Always ASK before you smoke.'
  Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya:
  'always ask before smoking in someone's
   house.'

  Farqi: bu yerda 'before you SMOKE' (gap),
  u yerda 'before SMOKING' (-ing).
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.


DIQQAT — 'SOMEONE ELSE'S':
  'someone ELSE'S plate' = birovning
  likopchasi

  Apostrof 'else' ga qo'shiladi, 'someone' ga
  emas:
     someone else's  ✓
     someone's else  ✗


BUYRUQ ShAKLLARI — UCh XIL:
  NEVER + fe'l   →  eng kuchli taqiq (1, 4, 8)
  DON'T + fe'l   →  oddiy taqiq (2, 3, 6)
  ALWAYS + fe'l  →  kuchli maslahat (5, 7)

  Ya'ni 3 ta 'never', 3 ta 'don't',
  2 ta 'always'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  table manners = dasturxon odobi
  fingers       = barmoqlar
  an elbow      = tirsak
  to blow your nose = burnini qoqmoq
  a knife       = pichoq
  a fork        = sanchqi
  a plate       = likopcha
  someone else's = birovning

items.sentence: 1  Never ...................... with your fingers.
items.uz: Hech qachon qo'lingiz bilan ovqat yemang.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'with your FINGERS' (barmoqlar bilan).
Barmoq bilan qilinadigan ish — OVQAT YEYISH.

1-rasmda ayol ikki qo'llab katta bo'lakni
yeyapti.

'to eat WITH your fingers' — predlog 'with'
(vosita).

items.sentence: 2  Don't ............... your elbows on the table.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'your ELBOWS ON the table'.
Tirsakni stolga QO'YISH → PUT.

2-rasmda ayol tirsaklarini stolga qo'ygan.

'to put something ON something' — joylashtirish.
'an elbow' = tirsak.

items.sentence: 3  Don't ...................... with your mouth full.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'with your MOUTH FULL' (og'zi to'la).
Og'iz bilan qilinadigan ish (yeyishdan tashqari)
— GAPIRISH.

Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni AYNAN shu:
'Don't talk with your mouth full.'

'with + ot + SIFAT' qurilmasi.

items.sentence: 4  Never ............... your nose at the table.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'your NOSE' (burun).
'to BLOW your nose' = burnini qoqmoq
(turg'un ibora).

4-rasmda erkak dasturxonda burnini qoqyapti.

Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
'don't blow your nose in public'.
Bu yerda esa 'AT THE TABLE'.

blow → BLEW (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.sentence: 5  Always ...................... before you smoke.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'before you SMOKE' — chekishdan oldin
nima qilish kerak? RUXSAT SO'RASH.

5-rasmda ayol dasturxonda sigaret tutgan.

Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
'always ASK before smoking in someone's house'.

Farqi: bu yerda 'before you SMOKE' (to'liq gap),
u yerda 'before SMOKING' (-ing).

KALIT: 'FOR dinner' — 'late FOR' turg'un
birikmasi.

RO'YXATDAGI YAGONA IKKI SO'ZLI SHAKL:
'be late'.
'late' — SIFAT, shuning uchun 'BE' fe'li kerak:
  'Don't BE late.' ✓
  'Don't late.'    ✗

Coursebook 100-bet: 'Don't be late for
appointments.'

items.sentence: 7  Always ...................... a knife and fork.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'a KNIFE AND FORK' — asboblardan
FOYDALANISH → USE.

7-rasmda erkak pichoq va sanchqi bilan
ovqatlanyapti.

DIQQAT — 1-BAND BILAN JUFT:
  1  Never EAT with your FINGERS.  (taqiq)
  7  Always USE a KNIFE AND FORK. (maslahat)
Kitob ataylab ikkalasini bergan.

'a knife' — ko'pligi KNIVES (f → ves).

items.sentence: 8  Never ....... food from someone else's plate.
items.uz: Hech qachon birovning likopchasidan ovqat olmang.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'FOOD FROM someone's plate' —
ovqatni OLISH → TAKE.

8-rasmda ayol yonidagi odamning likopchasidan
ovqat olyapti.

'take something FROM somewhere' — predlog
'from'.

DIQQAT — 'SOMEONE ELSE'S':
Apostrof 'ELSE' ga qo'shiladi:
  someone else's plate  ✓
  someone's else plate  ✗

exercises.instructionEn: Match the words to their opposites.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  dangerous  →  B  safe
  2  rude       →  E  polite
  3  upset      →  F  content
  4  upwards    →  C  downwards
  5  illegal    →  D  legal
  6  protect    →  A  destroy


HAR JUFTLIK BATAFSIL:

 1  DANGEROUS ↔ SAFE
    xavfli ↔ xavfsiz
    'It's dangerous to swim here.'
    'It's safe to swim here.'
    Coursebook 103-bet: 'There is always a
    danger of accidents.'

 2  RUDE ↔ POLITE
    qo'pol ↔ odobli
    Coursebook 100-bet:
    Xitoy — 'it's very RUDE'
    Yaponiya — 'it is POLITE to take a gift'
    Kitob ikkalasini ataylab bir betda bergan!

 3  UPSET ↔ CONTENT
    xafa, ko'ngli buzilgan ↔ mamnun, ko'ngli to'q
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
    'this makes people very UPSET'
    'content' — bu yerda SIFAT (mamnun),
    'mundarija' emas!

 4  UPWARDS ↔ DOWNWARDS
    yuqoriga qarab ↔ pastga qarab
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy:
    'chopsticks pointing UPWARDS'
    up + wards / down + wards

 5  ILLEGAL ↔ LEGAL
    qonunga xilof ↔ qonuniy
    Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog:
    'You mustn't park here — it's ILLEGAL.'
    'IL-' — inkor old qo'shimchasi.

 6  PROTECT ↔ DESTROY
    himoya qilmoq ↔ yo'q qilmoq
    Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa:
    'things we can do to PROTECT the
     environment'
    Grammar 63-bet: 'the DESTRUCTION of
    rainforests'


DIQQAT — 'IL-' INKOR QO'ShIMChASI:
  legal    →  ILlegal   (qonunga xilof)
  logical  →  ILlogical (mantiqsiz)

  'IL-' faqat 'L' bilan boshlanadigan
  so'zlarga qo'shiladi.

  Boshqa inkor qo'shimchalari:
     IM- (m, p oldidan): possible → IMpossible
                         polite → IMpolite
     IR- (r oldidan):    regular → IRregular
     IN- (qolganlar):    correct → INcorrect
     UN- (eng keng):     happy → UNhappy
                         safe → UNsafe

  DIQQAT: 'rude' ning ziddi 'IMPOLITE' ham
  bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bu mashqda 'POLITE'
  berilgan (2-band).


DIQQAT — '-WARDS' QO'ShIMChASI:
  Yo'nalish bildiradi:
     up + WARDS      = upwards (yuqoriga)
     down + WARDS    = downwards (pastga)
     back + WARDS    = backwards (orqaga)
     for + WARDS     = forwards (oldinga)
     to + WARDS      = towards (... tomon)

  'towards' — Coursebook 100-betda bor edi:
  'the toes are pointing TOWARDS the door'.


DIQQAT — 'CONTENT' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  content (SIFAT) = mamnun, ko'ngli to'q
     O'qilishi: /kənˈtent/ — urg'u OXIRIDA
  content (OT) = mundarija, tarkib
     O'qilishi: /ˈkɒntent/ — urg'u BOSHIDA

  Urg'u ma'noni o'zgartiradi!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  dangerous  = xavfli
  safe       = xavfsiz
  rude       = qo'pol
  polite     = odobli
  upset      = xafa
  content    = mamnun
  upwards    = yuqoriga qarab
  downwards  = pastga qarab
  illegal    = qonunga xilof
  legal      = qonuniy
  to protect = himoya qilmoq
  to destroy = yo'q qilmoq

pairs.whyUz:
dangerous ↔ safe

Coursebook 103-bet: 'There is always a DANGER
of accidents.'

'danger' (OT) → 'dangerous' (SIFAT).

rude ↔ polite

Coursebook 100-bet ikkalasini bir betda bergan:
  Xitoy: 'it's very RUDE' (o'pish haqida)
  Yaponiya: 'it is POLITE to take a gift'

'impolite' ham 'rude' bilan yaqin ma'noli.

upset ↔ content

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
'this makes people very UPSET'
(tayoqchalar haqida).

DIQQAT — 'CONTENT' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  SIFAT /kənˈtent/ = mamnun (urg'u OXIRIDA)
  OT /ˈkɒntent/ = mundarija (urg'u BOSHIDA)
Bu yerda SIFAT ma'nosida.

upwards ↔ downwards

Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
'never leave your chopsticks pointing UPWARDS
in your rice'.

'-WARDS' — yo'nalish qo'shimchasi:
upwards, downwards, backwards, forwards,
towards.

illegal ↔ legal

Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog:
'You mustn't park here — it's ILLEGAL.'

'IL-' — inkor old qo'shimchasi, faqat 'L'
bilan boshlanadigan so'zlarga:
  legal → ILlegal
  logical → ILlogical

protect ↔ destroy

Coursebook 99-bet, varaqaning birinchi gapi:
'things we can do to PROTECT the environment'

Grammar 63-bet, Amazon matni:
'the DESTRUCTION of rainforests'
(destroy → destruction).

Ikkalasi ham FE'L — zid juftlik.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues below and fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU: kasalliklar va maslahatlar
(Coursebook 101-betning takrori)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  COLD
  2  COUGH
  3  DENTIST
  4  HEADACHE
  5  SLEEP
  6  SORE


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  A: I feel very COLD.
    B: You should put a jumper on.
    (A: Juda sovqotdim.
     B: Jemper kiyishingiz kerak.)

 2  A: Doctor, I've got a bad COUGH.
    B: You should take some cough syrup.
    (A: Doktor, qattiq yo'talyapman.
     B: Yo'tal sharbatidan ichishingiz kerak.)

 3  A: Ooh! I've got toothache.
    B: You need to see a DENTIST.
    (A: Voy! Tishim og'riyapti.
     B: Tish shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.)

 4  A: I've got a HEADACHE.
    B: You should take an aspirin.
    (A: Boshim og'riyapti.
     B: Aspirin ichishingiz kerak.)

 5  A: What's wrong with you?
    B: I feel very tired. I need to get some
       SLEEP.
    (A: Sizga nima bo'ldi?
     B: Juda charchadim. Uxlab olishim kerak.)

 6  A: I've got a SORE throat and I think I've
       got the flu.
    B: Why don't you go home and go to bed?
    (A: Tomog'im og'riyapti va menimcha
        grippga chalindim.
     B: Uyga borib yotsangiz-chi?)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — JAVOB DOIM
DIALOGNING IKKINChI QISMIDA:

 1  'put a JUMPER on'  →  sovqotgan  →  COLD
 2  'COUGH SYRUP'      →  yo'tal     →  COUGH
 3  'toothache'        →  tish       →  DENTIST
 4  'take an ASPIRIN'  →  bosh og'rig'i
                                     →  HEADACHE
 5  'I feel very TIRED' →  uyqu      →  SLEEP
 6  '...THROAT'        →  og'riyotgan →  SORE

  Ya'ni HAR bandda javob qo'shni gapda
  yashiringan — taxmin kerak emas.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'A BAD COUGH':
  'a BAD cough' = qattiq yo'tal
  'bad' bu yerda 'yomon' emas, 'kuchli'
  ma'nosida.

  Shu kabi: a bad headache, a bad cold

  'cough' o'qilishi /kɒf/ — 'gh' = /f/.


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDAGI 'NEED TO SEE':
  'You NEED TO see a dentist.'
  'need to + fe'l' = ... qilish kerak

  'to SEE a dentist/doctor' = qabuliga bormoq
  ('ko'rmoq' emas).

  Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'See the dentist.'


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'SORE':
  'a SORE throat' = og'riyotgan tomoq
  'sore' — SIFAT (og'riyotgan, yallig'langan).

  Bo'shliq 'throat' dan OLDIN, demak SIFAT
  kerak — 'a sore throat' ✓
  ('a throat sore' ✗)


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'GET SOME SLEEP':
  'sleep' bu yerda OT va SANALMAYDIGAN,
  shuning uchun 'SOME' bilan:
     'get SOME sleep'  ✓
     'get A sleep'     ✗


KASALLIK ARTIKLLARI (Coursebook 101-betdan):
     a cough, a headache, a cold,
     a sore throat        →  'A' bilan
     the flu              →  'THE' bilan
     toothache            →  ARTIKLSIZ

  Bu mashqda ham shu qoida saqlangan:
     'a bad COUGH'      (a)
     'a HEADACHE'       (a)
     'a SORE throat'    (a)
     'the FLU'          (the)
     'toothache'        (artiklsiz!)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a cough    = yo'tal
  a dentist  = tish shifokori
  a headache = bosh og'rig'i
  sleep      = uyqu (sanalmaydigan)
  sore       = og'riyotgan
  a throat   = tomoq
  a jumper   = jemper
  an aspirin = aspirin

items.sentence: 1  A: I feel very ................ .   B: You should put a jumper on.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob gapida 'put a JUMPER on'
(jemper kiying) — demak odam SOVQOTGAN.

'I FEEL very ...' — 'feel' dan keyin SIFAT.
'cold' bu yerda SIFAT (sovqotgan), OT emas.

Coursebook 101-bet, 9-mashqning 3-rasmi.

items.sentence: 2  A: Doctor, I've got a bad ................ .   B: You should take some cough syrup.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob gapida 'COUGH SYRUP'
(yo'tal sharbati) — so'zning o'zi berilgan!

'a BAD cough' = qattiq yo'tal
('bad' bu yerda 'kuchli' ma'nosida).

'cough' o'qilishi /kɒf/ — 'gh' = /f/ tovushi.

items.sentence: 3  A: Ooh! I've got toothache.   B: You need to see a ................ .

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'I've got TOOTHACHE' (tish og'rig'i)
— tish bilan kim shug'ullanadi? DENTIST.

'to SEE a dentist' = qabuliga bormoq
('ko'rmoq' emas).

DIQQAT: 'toothache' ARTIKLSIZ (britancha),
lekin 'a DENTIST' — artikl bilan.

Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'See the dentist.'

items.sentence: 4  A: I've got a ................ .   B: You should take an aspirin.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob gapida 'take an ASPIRIN' —
aspirin BOSH OG'RIG'IGA ichiladi.

ARTIKL KALITI: 'I've got A ...' — demak 'a'
oladigan kasallik.
  a headache ✓
  toothache  ✗ (artiklsiz)
  the flu    ✗ ('the' kerak)

Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Take an aspirin.'

items.sentence: 5  B: I feel very tired. I need to get some ................ .

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'I feel very TIRED' — charchagan odamga
nima kerak? UYQU.

'get SOME sleep' = uxlab olmoq.
'sleep' bu yerda OT va SANALMAYDIGAN,
shuning uchun 'some' bilan ('a sleep' XATO).

Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Get some sleep.'

items.sentence: 6  A: I've got a ...................... throat and I think I've got the flu.
items.uz: Tomog'im og'riyapti va menimcha grippga chalindim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: bo'shliq 'THROAT' (tomoq) dan OLDIN
— demak SIFAT kerak.

'a SORE throat' = og'riyotgan tomoq
(turg'un birikma).

  'a sore throat'  ✓
  'a throat sore'  ✗

DIQQAT: 'the FLU' — 'the' bilan (kasallik
artikllari qoidasi).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and fill in the gaps with verbs from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta fe'l, har biri BIR marta):
  throw, creates, use, protect, light, smells,
  drop, pollute


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  PROTECT
  2  USE
  3  POLLUTE
  4  CREATES
  5  DROP
  6  SMELLS
  7  THROW
  8  LIGHT


TO'LIQ MAQOLA (javoblar bilan):

  'We can all help to PROTECT the environment
   and there are a lot of things we can do.
   To start with we should USE public transport
   because cars POLLUTE the air. Packaging from
   food products CREATES a lot of rubbish.
   We should not DROP rubbish in the streets
   because it looks and SMELLS horrible.
   We mustn't THROW rubbish in the sea either
   because fish will die. Lastly, we should
   never LIGHT fires in forests or all the
   trees will burn. We should all try to help
   make a difference!'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Hammamiz atrof-muhitni himoya qilishga
   yordam bera olamiz va qila oladigan ko'p
   ishlarimiz bor. Avvalo, jamoat transportidan
   foydalanishimiz kerak, chunki mashinalar
   havoni ifloslantiradi. Oziq-ovqat
   mahsulotlarining o'rami ko'p axlat hosil
   qiladi. Ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligimiz
   kerak, chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va
   dahshatli hidlaydi. Dengizga ham axlat
   tashlamasligimiz kerak, chunki baliqlar
   nobud bo'ladi. Nihoyat, o'rmonlarda hech
   qachon olov yoqmasligimiz kerak, aks holda
   barcha daraxtlar yonib ketadi. Hammamiz
   o'zgarish yasashga harakat qilishimiz kerak!'


ENG MUHIM KALIT — RO'YXATNING O'ZI:

  Ro'yxatda IKKI fe'l '-S' bilan berilgan:
     CREATES  va  SMELLS

  Qolgan oltitasi ASOSIY shaklda:
     throw, use, protect, light, drop, pollute

  Demak '-S' li fe'llar faqat III ShAXS BIRLIK
  ega bo'lgan bo'shliqlarga tushadi:

     4) 'PACKAGING ... CREATES'
        ('packaging' — sanalmaydigan → birlik)
     6) 'IT looks and SMELLS'
        ('it' — birlik)

  Boshqa hamma bo'shliqda modal fe'l yoki
  'to' bor, demak ASOSIY shakl kerak:
     1) 'help TO protect'
     2) 'we SHOULD use'
     3) 'cars POLLUTE' (ko'plik ega!)
     5) 'we should not DROP'
     7) 'we MUSTN'T throw'
     8) 'we should never LIGHT'

  Ya'ni ro'yxat javobning yarmini AYTIB
  turibdi!


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'help to ... THE ENVIRONMENT'
    Atrof-muhitni nima qilish kerak? HIMOYA.
    → PROTECT
    (Coursebook 99-bet varaqasining birinchi
     gapi: 'to PROTECT the environment')

 2  'we should ... PUBLIC TRANSPORT'
    Jamoat transportidan FOYDALANISH.
    → USE
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'USE public transport')

 3  'because CARS ... THE AIR'
    Mashinalar havoni IFLOSLANTIRADI.
    → POLLUTE
    DIQQAT: 'cars' — KO'PLIK, shuning uchun
    '-S' YO'Q!
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Cars pollute the air.')

 4  'PACKAGING ... A LOT OF RUBBISH'
    O'ram ko'p axlat HOSIL QILADI.
    → CREATES
    DIQQAT: 'packaging' — SANALMAYDIGAN,
    ya'ni BIRLIK → '-S' kerak!
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'The packaging creates
     a lot of rubbish.')

 5  'we should not ... RUBBISH IN THE STREETS'
    Ko'chaga axlat TASHLASh.
    → DROP
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Do not DROP rubbish
     in the street.')

 6  'because IT LOOKS AND ... HORRIBLE'
    Ko'rinadi va HIDLAYDI.
    → SMELLS
    DIQQAT: 'it' — BIRLIK, va 'looks' ham
    '-S' bilan → 'smells' ham '-S' bilan.
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'It looks and smells
     horrible.')

 7  'we mustn't ... RUBBISH IN THE SEA'
    Dengizga axlat ULOQTIRISh.
    → THROW
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Do not THROW plastic
     bottles into the sea.')

 8  'we should never ... FIRES IN FORESTS'
    O'rmonda olov YOQISh.
    → LIGHT
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Never LIGHT fires in
     forests.')


DIQQAT — 'DROP' va 'THROW' FARQI:
  5) 'DROP rubbish in the streets'
     — tushirib yubormoq (beixtiyor, pastga)
  7) 'THROW rubbish in the sea'
     — uloqtirmoq (ataylab, uzoqqa)

  Kitob ikkalasini ataylab bir matnda bergan.


DIQQAT — 'EITHER' INKORDA:
  'We mustn't throw rubbish in the sea EITHER.'
  = dengizga HAM tashlamasligimiz kerak

  Inkor gapda 'ham' → EITHER ('too' emas).


DIQQAT — MAQOLANING TUZILISh SO'ZLARI:
  'TO START WITH' = avvalo
  'LASTLY'        = nihoyat, oxirida
  'EITHER'        = ham (inkorda)

  Bu so'zlar fikrlarni TARTIBGA soladi.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE A DIFFERENCE':
  'try to help MAKE A DIFFERENCE'
  = o'zgarish yasashga harakat qilmoq

  Turg'un ibora: bir narsani yaxshi tomonga
  o'zgartirmoq.


BU MAQOLA — COURSEBOOK 99-BETNING TAKRORI:
  Maqoladagi deyarli har gap 99-betdagi
  'HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT' varaqasidan
  olingan. Farqi:
     varaqada — BUYRUQ mayli
                ('Use public transport.')
     bu yerda — MODAL fe'l
                ('We should use public
                  transport.')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to start with = avvalo
  packaging     = o'ram
  food products = oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari
  either        = ham (inkorda)
  lastly        = nihoyat
  to make a difference = o'zgarish yasamoq

items.sentence: 1  We can all help to ................ the environment
items.uz: Hammamiz atrof-muhitni himoya qilishga yordam bera olamiz

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'THE ENVIRONMENT' — atrof-muhitni
HIMOYA qilish.

SHAKL KALITI: 'help TO ...' — 'to' dan keyin
ASOSIY shakl → 'protect' ('protects' emas).

Coursebook 99-bet, varaqaning birinchi gapi:
'things we can do to PROTECT the environment'.

items.sentence: 2  To start with we should ................ public transport

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'PUBLIC TRANSPORT' — undan
FOYDALANISH.

SHAKL KALITI: 'we SHOULD ...' — modaldan keyin
ASOSIY shakl.

Coursebook 99-bet: 'USE public transport
(i.e. buses, trains, trams).'

'to start with' = avvalo.

items.sentence: 3  because cars ...................... the air.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'THE AIR' — havoni
IFLOSLANTIRISH.

SHAKL KALITI: ega 'CARS' — KO'PLIK,
shuning uchun '-S' YO'Q:
  'cars pollute'   ✓
  'cars pollutes'  ✗

Coursebook 99-bet: 'Cars pollute the air.'

items.sentence: 4  Packaging from food products ......................... a lot of rubbish.
items.uz: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining o'rami ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'A LOT OF RUBBISH' — axlat
HOSIL QILISH.

ENG MUHIM SHAKL KALITI: ega 'PACKAGING' —
SANALMAYDIGAN ot, ya'ni BIRLIK
→ fe'lga '-S' kerak!

Ro'yxatda 'creates' allaqachon '-S' bilan
berilgan — bu kalit.

Coursebook 99-bet: 'The packaging CREATES a
lot of rubbish.'

items.sentence: 5  We should not ......................... rubbish in the streets

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'RUBBISH IN THE STREETS' —
ko'chaga axlat TUSHIRIB YUBORISH.

SHAKL KALITI: 'should not ...' — modaldan
keyin ASOSIY shakl.

DIQQAT — 'DROP' va 'THROW' FARQI:
  DROP  — tushirib yubormoq (beixtiyor)
  THROW — uloqtirmoq (7-band, dengizga)

Coursebook 99-bet: 'Do not DROP rubbish in
the street.'

items.sentence: 6  because it looks and ......................... horrible.
items.uz: chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'HORRIBLE' bilan keladigan his
fe'li — HIDLASH.

SHAKL KALITI — IKKI TOMONI:
  1) ega 'IT' — BIRLIK
  2) yonidagi 'LOOKS' ham '-S' bilan
  → 'smells' ('-S' bilan)

Ro'yxatda 'smells' allaqachon '-S' bilan
berilgan.

Coursebook 99-bet: 'It looks and SMELLS
horrible.'

items.sentence: 7  We mustn't ......................... rubbish in the sea either

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'IN THE SEA' — dengizga
ULOQTIRISH.

SHAKL KALITI: 'mustn't ...' — modaldan keyin
ASOSIY shakl.

DIQQAT — 'EITHER':
Inkor gapda 'ham' → EITHER ('too' emas).

Coursebook 99-bet: 'Do not THROW plastic
bottles into the sea. Fish will die.'

items.sentence: 8  Lastly, we should never ......................... fires in forests
items.uz: Nihoyat, o'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmasligimiz kerak

commonMistake.whyUz:
MA'NO KALITI: 'FIRES' — olov YOQISH.
'to LIGHT a fire' = olov yoqmoq.

SHAKL KALITI: 'should never ...' — modaldan
keyin ASOSIY shakl.

Coursebook 99-bet: 'Never LIGHT fires in
forests. Trees will burn.'

light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'lastly' = nihoyat, oxirida.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 56-bet — dasturxon odobi, zid so'zlar, atrof-muhit.

groups.explanationUz: Coursebook 101-betdagi qoida shu yerda ham saqlangan.

patterns.exampleEn: Never eat with your fingers. Always use a knife and fork. Don't be late for dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: Qo'lingiz bilan ovqat yemang. Doim pichoq va sanchqidan foydalaning. Kechki ovqatga kechikmang.
patterns.explanationUz:
Dasturxon odobi qoidalari — buyruq maylida.
'be late' — 'late' SIFAT bo'lgani uchun 'BE'
kerak.

patterns.formula: I'VE GOT A / THE / — + [kasallik].  —  You should + [maslahat].
patterns.exampleEn: I've got a headache. — You should take an aspirin.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kasallik + maslahat dialogi.
Har kasallik O'Z artiklini oladi.

patterns.exampleEn: We should not drop rubbish in the streets because it looks and smells horrible.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligimiz kerak, chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qoida + sabab — 99-betdagi varaqaning
modal bilan qayta yozilgan shakli.

patterns.exampleEn: Packaging creates a lot of rubbish. Cars pollute the air.
patterns.exampleUz: O'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi. Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
III shaxs BIRLIK → -S qo'shiladi.
'packaging' sanalmaydigan → BIRLIK.
'cars' → KO'PLIK, -S YO'Q.

patterns.exampleEn: We mustn't throw rubbish in the sea either.
